text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D for gains, then buying them back at higher prices, reminds me that a past sale price should not drive my next decision; I should assess each stock on its current prospects and price.","Locking in gains feels good, but I should avoid selling just to make a gain feel real; I should consider whether a sale still fits my long-term plan.","I often go several periods without trading, and that can help me avoid impulsive reactions; I should still review my whole portfolio periodically and make deliberate changes when my goals or the investment case warrant them."]}
